poses.label: Stand
poses.description: Rest the bar on your upper back with your knees almost straight.

poses.label: Hinge
poses.description: Push your hips back and tip forward with a flat back.

poses.label: Stretch
poses.description: Stop when your hamstrings stretch and your back is still steady.

poses.label: Stand up
poses.description: Bring your hips forward to return to standing.

limitations: The loop starts after unracking. The current renderer has no rack prop for this setup.
The two catalog variants use different knee bend throughout the working path.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
